account.description:
Account is the 1Password account the vault belongs to, as a sign-in
address or account UUID.

vault.description: Vault is the name or UUID of the vault holding the item.

item.description: Item is the name or UUID of the item within the vault.

field.description: Field is the name of the field to read from the item, e.g. `password`.

Secret.description: Secret addresses a single field of a 1Password item, in the same terms as an `op://` reference: `op://<vault>/<item>/<field>`, resolved against Account.
